questions.q: Why would you write a singular test instead of using one of the four generic tests?
options: The assertion is specific to your own business logic and isn't a reusable, general-purpose rule dbt could ship as a built-in
Singular tests run faster than generic tests in every case
Generic tests are deprecated in current versions of dbt
Singular tests are required before a project can use any generic test
questions.explain: Something like 'an order's total payment should never be negative' depends entirely on your own data model, so it can't be a generic, reusable test.

questions.q: Where does a singular test live, and how does it get its name?
options: As a .sql file in the tests/ directory — the test's name comes directly from the filename
Inside the model's own .sql file, as a commented-out block
In dbt_project.yml, under a tests: key
Singular tests have no name; dbt assigns one randomly at runtime
questions.explain: A singular test is just a .sql file in tests/, and dbt derives its name from that filename — no YAML declaration required to define it.

questions.q: In the real example assert_total_payment_amount_is_positive.sql, what makes the test fail?
options: The query returns any row where an order's summed payment amount is less than zero
The query returns zero rows
The referenced model fails to compile
The test always fails on the first run by design
questions.explain: Like every dbt test, a singular test fails when its select statement returns rows — those rows are the specific violations.

questions.q: How do you add a description to a singular test, since it isn't declared in a model's schema.yml?
options: By creating a small YAML entry under a data_tests: key, referencing the test by its name, typically in tests/schema.yml
Descriptions are not possible for singular tests under any circumstances
By renaming the .sql file to include the description as text
By adding a --description flag when running dbt test
questions.explain: A tests/schema.yml file with a data_tests: entry lets you attach a description to a singular test by name.

questions.q: According to this lesson, what signal suggests a singular test should be promoted into a generic test instead?
options: You notice yourself writing nearly the same singular test, with the same shape of query, against several different models
The singular test has been passing for more than 30 days
The singular test references more than one model
dbt automatically flags singular tests that run for more than 10 seconds
questions.explain: Repetition across models is the signal to write the logic once as a generic test and reuse it everywhere, instead of duplicating similar singular tests.
